Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
mag...@elvis.umd.umich.edu (Steven Sierb) writes:
>I had a quickie question... Does Undead persitance only gove one press or
>a press until <no cards played> for 3 rounds... I know it's easy but
>it's always a good idea to be sure...

You only get the first press from Undead persistence. The rest must
come from other sources (Trap, Appolonius, Hawg, Dead-End Alley, etc).

>Also another easy one. we have been playing that if a vampire has no blood
>when Society of Leopold is played on it, the vampire must be burned. Is
>this correct. It's pretty kewl with cryptic missions , thadius zho, disease and
>such!

The vampire must be burned if it cannot spend the blood during the untap.
An empty vampire isn't necesarily burned when the card is played - he could
get into combat and steal some blood, for example, before his next untap
phase.

Not exactly. If a Vampire has no Blood when the society hits it, it
would go to Torpor. If it is already in Torpor, it would be burned.
